text:
anya: Heads-up team: finalizing press/analyst logistics for launch next Wed. Need to confirm embargo time, who signs off on quotes, and any NDA asks.

jess: I'll own quotes + the fact-check queue. Drafting language now; can we avoid raw benchmark numbers in the main quote?

marco: Recommended embargo 10am PT to align with US/EMEA coverage. Happy to shift if it helps APAC.

priya: 10am PT is fine. Suggest a 9:15 PT 20-min canary with top-tier analysts to surface any blockers.

press-bot: [automated] Provisional embargo set for 2026-04-14T10:00:00-07:00. Reminder schedule: -24h, -1h.

kevin: For brief cadence: 9:15-9:35 canary, 10:00-11:30 analyst block (3x30m), 16:00-17:30 APAC-friendly office hours (3x30m). I'll draft invites.

jess: Quote draft: "Redwood Inference enables engineering teams to run production LLM inference with predictable latency and cost controls, so teams can ship features reliably." Feedback?

marco: Looks good. Legal: any sensitivity with "production" claim?

legal-bot: [automated] Flag: product claims should avoid absolute superlatives without attribution. Recommend "consistent low-latency" vs "predictable latency" if not backed by a certified benchmark.

jess: OK switching to "consistent low-latency". Will send to legal for quick review.

priya: Note: Tech Week analyst (AnalystName) requested a one-way CDA to see embargoed p99 numbers. Is that acceptable?

marco: Product must vet any CSVs. If product can't approve in time we offer anonymized ranges or descriptive language.

anya: Decision: jess -> get quote/legal sweep; kevin -> build coverage sheet with primary/backup contact + preferred format; priya -> maintain NDA/CDA tracker and liaise with analyst.

press-bot: [automated] assets checklist: slide deck, one-pager, FAQ, embargo note. Missing: signed CDAs for AnalystName (if required).

jess: I'll remove numeric benchmark slide until product signs off. Prepare a fact-sheet that says "detailed metrics available to vetted analysts under CDA during embargo."

legal-bot: [automated] CDA template ready. If approved, send via secure link; request 4-hour turnaround for signing.

kevin: I created the coverage sheet: https://docs.example.com/launch/press-coverage-matrix (internal). Added gatekeepers, time zones, and recording policy.

anya: Excellent. Also confirm on-the-record policy at the top of each brief: "On the record unless explicitly stated; background comments will be marked." priya please make a visible slide.

priya: Will do. Also flagging any analysts who require non-standard attribution language.

anya: Great. Final: jess ping legal by EOD, product to confirm benchmark CSV availability, priya to track CDAs. We'll reconvene 30m before the canary. :rocket:
